summary: ST-005 is complete. lib/core/injection/injection.config.dart exists and was successfully regenerated by build_runner. All 15 relative import paths in the generated file resolve to real files on disk. No package:nextone_core or package:models references remain anywhere in lib/. configureDependencies() is correctly defined in lib/core/injection/injection.dart, exported via the nextone.dart umbrella, and called from main.dart. The worker made no manual file modifications — only build_runner was executed — keeping the step correctly scoped. Three notes are documented below; none are blocking for ST-005.

issues.description: The generated file uses relative imports throughout (e.g., ../../application/auth/auth_bloc.dart) rather than package:nextone/ package imports. ARCHITECTURE.md §4 prohibits relative imports across layer boundaries. This is driven by the preferRelativeImports: true flag in the @InjectableInit annotation in injection.dart. All relative paths resolve correctly to real files. Because this is generated code controlled by a codegen annotation — not hand-written code — the architecture rule is not violated in the hand-authored layer. The annotation setting itself is inherited from the pre-consolidation codebase and can be changed to preferRelativeImports: false in a later cleanup step (ST-008) to align generated output with the import convention.

The generated file imports IAuthService under two different prefixes: _i191 (from interfaces/auth/i_auth_service.dart directly) and _i1071 (via services_exports.dart barrel). The lazySingleton registration uses _i1071.IAuthService while the AuthBloc dependency lookup uses gh<_i191.IAuthService>(). Both resolve to the same Dart type because services_exports.dart re-exports the same class, so GetIt will resolve correctly at runtime. This is a codegen artefact, not a functional defect.

The actual on-disk file structure uses nested subdirectories (e.g., implementations/artist_repository/artist_repository.dart) rather than the flat paths specified in ARCHITECTURE.md §6 (e.g., implementations/artist_repository.dart). This divergence was introduced in ST-001 and is outside ST-005 scope. The DI generator resolved all paths correctly against the real structure. The path discrepancy should be addressed in ST-008 if structural alignment with ARCHITECTURE.md is required.

fix_instructions.action: Defer to ST-008. In lib/core/injection/injection.dart, change preferRelativeImports: true to preferRelativeImports: false in the @InjectableInit annotation, then re-run build_runner to regenerate injection.config.dart with package:nextone/ imports to align with ARCHITECTURE.md §4 import conventions.

No action required. The dual-prefix import is a codegen artefact and resolves correctly at runtime. If NOTE-001 is actioned (switching to package imports), the generator may consolidate to a single import path for IAuthService naturally.

Defer to ST-008. Evaluate whether the actual nested subdirectory structure should be flattened to match ARCHITECTURE.md §6. If yes, move files and re-run build_runner; if the nested structure is intentional (an ST-001 deviation), update ARCHITECTURE.md to reflect the true paths.
